gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that getFirstEnum returns the default when no enum value matches the target int, and that generateBitVectors correctly deduplicates repeated enum values v
ADDED i2: Mock always returns 0, so searching for -1 will never match any enum constant.
ADDED i3: No enum constant maps to -1, so getFirstEnum returns the defaultMode (AUTOSELECT_FILTERING).
ADDED i4: Build an array of 9 FilteringMode values, all effectively AUTOSELECT_FILTERING (both defaultMode and noMatchResult refer to the same constant).
ADDED i5: generateBitVectors deduplicates via EnumSet; only AUTOSELECT_FILTERING (ordinal 0) is present, so the result is a single-element array with bit 0 set: {1L}.
